description: This script generates dynamic loader code for various graphics API interfaces (EGL, OpenGL, WGL) by creating header and source files based on XML registry data. It automates the creation of function pointer loaders for different graphics APIs used in the ANGLE project.

methods.name: write_header
methods.description: Generates a header file for API function loaders, defining function pointer externs and a loader function.

methods.name: write_source
methods.description: Generates a source file that defines function pointers and a loader function implementation.

methods.name: gen_libegl_loader
methods.description: Creates loader files for EGL API based on XML registry data.

methods.name: gen_gl_loader
methods.description: Creates loader files for OpenGL ES and extension APIs based on XML registry data.

methods.name: gen_egl_loader
methods.description: Creates loader files for EGL API with multiple versions and extensions.

methods.name: gen_wgl_loader
methods.description: Creates loader files for WGL API extensions and version.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that handles command-line arguments and triggers loader generation functions.
